principle: Clients receive only licensed data and approved derivatives. The AI assistant may be shown some fields for explanation that it may not disclose. The enterprise's data is read-only to every AI component.

never_disclose_to_any_client: internal/* (SMI formula and inputs, model specification and coefficients)
respondent-level or cell-level data for unlicensed segments
global_rules.other_clients: Do not access, disclose, confirm, or deny the existence, scope, or content of any other client's engagement or custom study.
global_rules.derived_disclosure: Derived figures (differences, trends, averages, margins of error) may be disclosed only if computed exclusively from fields the client is licensed to receive AND they do not reveal or allow reconstruction of an unlicensed segment or a non-disclosable field. Computing an unlicensed segment by combining licensed figures (e.g., national minus licensed regions) is prohibited.
global_rules.predictions: Forecasts are Halvorsen model outputs and must be presented as predictions with their intervals, not as facts. Driver attributions are model attributions, not established causes.
global_rules.modification: No AI component may create, modify, or delete enterprise data. Corrections to enterprise data are made only by Halvorsen Data Governance through its change process.
